tagline: The people who should run your kitchen, your floor and your brand
intro: Marlow Search is a small search firm for restaurants, hotels and consumer brands. We find general managers, executive chefs and brand leaders, and we introduce them one at a time.
audience: Restaurant groups, independent hotels and consumer brands in New York and along the East Coast, hiring at general manager, executive chef and director level.
pricing_note: A percentage of first-year base salary, invoiced in two parts: one when the search begins and one when your new hire starts.

services.title: Executive search
services.description: Retained searches for general managers, operations leaders and directors, run by one partner from the first call to the signed offer.

services.title: Culinary leadership
services.description: Executive chefs, chefs de cuisine and culinary directors for restaurant groups and hotels that take the food as seriously as the room.

services.title: Brand and retail leaders
services.description: Heads of brand, retail directors and flagship store leaders for consumer brands opening or growing in New York and on the East Coast.

services.title: Confidential searches
services.description: Quiet searches for a seat that is still filled, handled with discretion on both sides of the introduction.

process.title: We listen
process.description: A long first conversation about the role, the team and the room. We want to know what the right person will be like on their first Tuesday.

process.title: We look, quietly
process.description: We approach people we know and people we have watched for a while, and we talk with each of them before you ever hear their name.

process.title: We introduce
process.description: You meet a short list, one person at a time, with our honest notes on each. We stay close through the offer and the first months.

proof.text: She found us a chef who cooks the way our guests remember.
One introduction, one hire, and they are still with us.
proof.source: Managing director, a boutique hotel group (sample)

proof.text: Every candidate already knew our room and our menu.
